meta.title: Device Faker
meta.description: Per-app device profiles and reusable templates

limits: Requires a Zygisk API v4 compatible loader. Supports ARM64 apps only. Status does not prove injection.
stopHelp: Stopping blocks new injections. Restart target apps to clear process-local changes; existing global sessions are scheduled for restoration. If cleanup fails, reboot.
conflict: Standalone Device Faker is active. Disable it and reboot before enabling this engine.
reboot: Wait for toolbox startup to finish. After an installation or update, reboot the device.
packageHelp: Use one package per line. A bare package also applies to cloned users as a fallback; append {'@'}0 or {'@'}999 for one user. Direct app records replace template records in full.
configHelp: Edit templates, apps and advanced fields in TOML. Preview validates without applying or enabling. Import leaves the original module configuration untouched.
globalWarning: This configuration changes global properties or display density while a target app is foreground. Other apps may observe these changes. Apply only if you accept this behavior.
restartHelp: Configuration is saved independently of the power control. Restart target apps after applying or changing the power state.
addProfile: Add a template or app profile
templateName: Template name (leave empty for direct app records)
profileRequired: Enter at least one package key and one device field.
tooLarge: Configuration must be at most 48 KiB.
cleanupHelp: Recovery is incomplete. Stop again to retry. If display recovery remains blocked, check the system display settings before retrying.
changed: Saved state changed. Your draft is retained; refresh and review before applying.

warnings.overlap: {target}: {count} assignments overlap. Direct app entries replace templates; the first matching template wins.
warnings.delete_requires_global: Property deletion is skipped in strict COW mode.
warnings.pi_priority: Play Integrity takes priority when both engines target the same process.
warnings.mapping_hide_ignored: Mapping hiding is ignored because Android retains pointers to property areas.

errors.engine_failed: The operation could not be completed. Retry or check the root manager; technical details are available.

errors.power_changed: Saved state changed. Your draft is retained; refresh and review before applying.

errors.no_targets: Enter at least one package key and one device field.
errors.standalone_conflict: Standalone Device Faker is active. Disable it and reboot before enabling this engine.
errors.startup_not_ready: Wait for toolbox startup to finish. After an installation or update, reboot the device.
errors.recovery_pending: Recovery is incomplete. Stop again to retry. If display recovery remains blocked, check the system display settings before retrying.
errors.invalid_config: Invalid TOML configuration. Correct the draft and preview again.
